name: dotdot_literal_check
description: Rejects any individual part containing a literal '..' segment (plus any absolute component), but never normalizes-and-compares against base at all. This over-rejects a legitimate '..' that still resolves within base (e.g. "reports/../public"), because it looks only at the raw, pre-join part text rather than the resolved path. A plausible 'forgot the allowed edge case' fix: the author reasoned '..' is always dangerous and blocked it outright instead of checking containment.
